judgments.supporting_quote:
Broken Separator (cage)
--- CELL ---
Cracked separator or separator in pieces.
Change end cover O-ring or end cover gasket.

Motor does
not come up to
nominal speed
--- CELL ---
Check the start load of the motor.
Abnormal noises, vibrations, temperatures or leakage could cause damage to the pump.
Monitor the correct functioning of any auxiliary connections.

For single common-main bilge systems, the control valves required in the branches from the bilge
                 main are to be accessible at all times for maintenance.

3. Discharge pressure higher than calculated. Verify with
                                                 a pressure gauge.

When repacking the stuffing box, if so
       equipped, be sure new packing rings are the correct size and length and installed with cuts staggered,
       and also that the packing rings do not block off the opening for the water seal ring
